name: Houzuki Ayano
source:
A girl of mysterious circumstances who agrees to be adopted by [url=http://vndb.org/c12894]Daichi[/url]. She seems to already know [url=http://vndb.org/c12895]Kaede[/url]. When she is adopted, she becomes the eldest daughter of the Houzuki family and the others call her onee-sama or nee-san.

Her hair is a different length in the CGs than it is in sprites.

[spoiler]If she is chosen to inherit her step-father's estate, she runs away and becomes a prostitute. Unfortunately one of her clients recognizes her as a girl he once abused under orders from her father and reports her for money.[/spoiler]
